vibe: Futuristic, cutting-edge, technical, builder-first. Not just another DeFi app, but core infrastructure. Deep depth, glassmorphism, glowing 3D objects against dark voids.

surface_strategies.glass_panels: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] hover:bg-white/[0.04] transition-all duration-300
surface_strategies.glow_effects: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500/10 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity

hero_3d.description: 3D floating glass shield with electric blue and amber core.
hero_3d.usage: Place in the right half of the Hero Section. Add a continuous slow up/down float animation via Framer Motion. Do not apply a heavy dark overlay; let the colors pop against the dark background.

intent_node_safe.usage: Use as thumbnail or visual indicator inside the 'Safe/Approved' INTENT-001 and INTENT-002 cards.

intent_node_rogue.description: 3D shattered glass data sphere emitting warning orange/red light.
intent_node_rogue.usage: Use prominently in the 'Blocked/High-Risk' INTENT-003 card and the 'Simulate Rogue Market' active state.

features_bg.description: Abstract 3D dark glass layers with subtle blue edge lighting.
features_bg.usage: Use as a background image with `object-cover` and a `bg-black/80` or `bg-[#040914]/90` overlay for the Features grid or overall page background to give deep texture.

components_strategy.header: Sticky navigation, backdrop-blur-md bg-[#040914]/80, 1px border-b border-white/5. Includes Brand Logo (text 'AEGIS' in JetBrains Mono), Navigation Links, and a 'Launch App' Primary Button.
components_strategy.hero: Two-column grid on desktop. Left: H1 heading, high-contrast subtext, and CTA buttons ('View Documentation', 'Simulate Exploit'). Right: The `hero_3d` asset floating. Background must have subtle radial gradient glows (blue top-right, cyan bottom-left).
components_strategy.market_bar: A sticky glass bar (bottom or just below hero). Displays Live SUI/USDC Price, 24h Vol, Network TPS. Use `font-mono` for numbers. Flash green/red on mock data updates.
components_strategy.live_dashboard: The core interactive piece. A bento grid layout (e.g., 3 columns). Includes 3 Intent Cards (INTENT-001, INTENT-002, INTENT-003). Each card must show a Risk Score (0-100), Status Badge, and small 3D node image. Use an interactive 'Kill Switch' button on the dashboard header.
components_strategy.intent_detail_modal: Shadcn Dialog or Sheet. Triggered by clicking an Intent Card. Must include a risk timeline chart (use Recharts, AreaChart with gradient fill), Object ID (font-mono), and dynamic fields (Signer, Gas, Gas Budget) with visual risk breakdown.
components_strategy.problem_section: Focus on typography and stark contrast. 'Over $20M+ lost to agent exploits.' Use high contrast white/red numbers against the dark background.
components_strategy.code_section: A glassmorphism terminal-like window. Show 3 lines of Move code (e.g., `public entry fun execute_intent...`). Use syntax highlighting colors (Keywords in blue/pink, strings in green).
components_strategy.features_grid: 8 Bento-style cards. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide (e.g., Shield, Activity, Lock). Some cards can span 2 columns. Apply `features_bg` lightly in the background of cards.
components_strategy.interactive_controls: Include 3 specific buttons in a control panel: 'Kill Switch' (Danger red, locks the dashboard), 'Simulate Rogue Market' (Triggers high-risk intents to appear), 'Reset Demo' (Restores safe state).
components_strategy.cta: Massive typography 'Secure Your Agents.' with final 'Deploy Firewall' button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary packages: `yarn add framer-motion recharts lucide-react clsx tailwind-merge`.
CRITICAL: Set the global background color in index.css to `#040914` and text color to `#FFFFFF`.
Use standard HTML tags for layout structure, heavily styled with Tailwind CSS.
Implement the Glassmorphism style exactly as defined: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/10`.
Use Framer Motion for floating elements (e.g., `<motion.img animate={{ y: [-10, 10, -10] }} transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 4, ease: 'easeInOut' }} />`).
For the Risk Timeline Chart in the modal, use Recharts `<AreaChart>` with a `defs` gradient `linearGradient` for a modern look.
CRITICAL: All interactive elements, buttons, and key data points MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="kill-switch-btn"`, `data-testid="intent-card-001"`).
Avoid using any purple or solid black. Stick to the Deep Slate, Electric Blue, Cyan, and status colors provided.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the precise URLs mapped in `media_urls`.
For the Move code snippet, wrap it in a `<pre><code>` block with custom Tailwind text colors to simulate syntax highlighting (e.g., `text-blue-400` for `public entry fun`).
Use `Outfit` for headings by adding it to your Google Fonts import and Tailwind config. Use `JetBrains Mono` for all Object IDs, Hashes, and Data points to reinforce the technical/builder aesthetic.
